content_zh: 燕郊镇隶属于河北省廊坊市，隔着一条潮白河与北京相邻。这里是30万“北漂”的居所，通过跨省公交连接着北京的交通枢纽和CBD。在京津冀一体化、疏解非首都功能和通州行政副中心等设想被提出后，燕郊又因其特殊的地理位置成为了相关政策的试验田。“临时”似乎是这里的核心属性，临时的租房，临时的规划，临时的设施，临时的文件……这场展览探索了“临时”如何在燕郊被习惯、对抗、消解和转化：在结冰的潮白河上栽一棵树，拍摄两个陌生人在危楼的篝火旁相遇的一刻，录制凌晨的跨省公交上的鼾声，用租房和按摩广告做成彩色玻璃，在废墟上设置一条不存在的地铁……
content_en: Yanjiao Town, Langfang City, Hebei Province, lies adjacent to Beijing across the Chaobaihe River. It is home to 300,000 'Beijing drifters' and connected to the capital's transport hubs and CBDs through interprovincial buses. Following proposals for Beijing-Tianjin-Heibei integration, the relocation of non-capital functions, and the establishment of Tongzhou administrative subcentre, the unique location of Yanjiao has rendered it a testing ground for policies. Everything seems to be 'temporary' there: temporary housing, temporary planning, temporary facilities, temporary documents...This exhibition explores how 'temporariness' is accomodated, resisted, dissolved and transformed in Yanjiao: planting a tree on the frozen Chaobaihe River; capturing the moment two strangers meet by bonfire in a dilapidated building; recording snores aboard an interprovincial bus at dawn; crafting stained glass from rental and massage flyers; and setting up a non-existent metro line upon ruins...
